build_task_template: build a PHYRE task scene with walls, bars, and a ball using the build_task template function
add_static_bar: create a static bar object in the PHYRE scene with specified scale, angle, and position
add_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object in the PHYRE scene at a given center and top position
update_task_relationships: update the task to require the ball touching the target using SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to SolutionTier.PRE_TWO_BALLS to classify difficulty level
